explanation:
[EFFECT] Humidity has a non-monotonic effect. Very low humidity (near 0%) shows some strongly negative values (around −0.5), mid-range humidity (roughly 20–60%) sits slightly above zero (~+0.1), and very high humidity above 80% drives contributions sharply downward, reaching about −0.8 at near-saturation levels. The most favourable humidity is in the moderate range.
[IMPORTANCE] A moderately important feature with a vertical range of about 0.9–1.0 log-units; comparable to month and ranked around third or fourth.
